verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's schedule docs describe mapping coverage needs (docs-12) and escalation policies tied to schedules (docs-7), and a community comment confirms that calendar overrides exist in the product (comm-4), but no evidence details a self-service flow for taking an override, swapping a shift, or requesting coverage without admin involvement — the same community comment actually calls overrides 'clunky,' undercutting a smooth self-service experience. Missing for 10: first-party docs on override/shift-swap UI or API, evidence of coverage-request workflow, and confirmation these actions require no admin intervention.
